doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Duke Ellington and Count Basie
summary: He loves Ellington but was emotionally more drawn to Basie's unified rhythmic band.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well I’ll throw a couple of words or phrases at you, and see if they have any reaction. Duke Ellington?

I love the Duke’s music. When I grew up though in terms of emotionally I was more drawn to Count Basie’s band. And there was something about the rhythmic unison feeling of that band, it was like one pulsing organism, that emotionally got to me even more than Duke’s band and Duke’s writing, although unquestionably he’s one of the towering geniuses of the music, clearly.
